[ASSISTANT_SAID] Early baseballs were made from leather and stitched with yarn, making them heavier and harder to hit.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The evolution of baseball equipment started in the early 20th century with lighter, thinner wood bats for greater control and power.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] In the 1970s, aluminum bats were introduced, leading to faster and more powerful hitting, but they are no longer used in professional baseball due to safety concerns.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Football equipment has undergone significant changes since its inception in the late 1800s, starting with footballs made of pig bladders that were heavier and rounder than modern footballs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Leather footballs were developed over time, becoming lighter and more aerodynamic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Early football players wore little protection, leading to many injuries; helmets were introduced in the 1920s but were made of leather and offered little protection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The first plastic helmets were introduced in the 1940s, providing much more protection than leather helmets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Nowadays, football players wear specialized equipment including helmets, shoulder pads, knee pads, and gloves to enhance performance and protect against injuries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sports equipment has evolved significantly due to advancements in materials, technology, design, and safety regulation, transforming sports like baseball and football.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The future of sports equipment may see further technological and material advancements.
